blocks.text: A one-eyed beggar who has held the same spot on the fish market steps in [[Port Vellen]] for twenty years. Sef sees everything and sells most of it: a copper for gossip, silver for the truth, gold for the truth *and* his silence. Survived the [[Night of Broken Lanterns]] — his lantern was the only one on the front that stayed lit.

Sef's lantern stayed lit because it's the old shrine-lantern of drowned Maro — the working that snuffed the harbor couldn't touch it. Sef doesn't know this. [[Brother Aldous]] does, and quietly refills its oil himself.
